items.title: Stanford Research Open-Sources Memorilla, a Latent Memory Module for Frozen LLMs
items.snippet: Stanford researchers released Memorilla, an open-source memory system that compresses a document collection into 16 memory tokens for a frozen Qwen3-8B. It reaches 84.33% on FactKG using 108x fewer document tokens than full context. The post Stanford Research Open-Sources Memorilla, a Latent Memory Module for Frozen LLMs appeared first on MarkTechPost .

items.title: Vercel Releases UI SDK: 50+ UI Behaviors for AI Coding Agents
items.snippet: Vercel Labs released Vercel UI SDK, an Apache-2.0 beta library of 50+ UI behaviors. Coding agents compose them into accessible components for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid and Web Components, with a bridge for direct UI control. items.title: Grok Bot: What Changes When You Can Build AI Teammates
items.snippet: Lauren Tan and Roman Ugarte join this episode of the Lightcone to go in deep on how they built and deployed Grok Bot. They explain how automated tests and codebase guardrails help agents check their own work, why bots should earn broader access over time, and why faster and cheaper execution makes direction and clear goal setting even more important.
